rows.en: Taki!? Taki, is that you! What on earth are you doing here?

Oh, that's right, isn't it? Takeshi, you two used to compete against each other in the All-Japan Motocross Championship, didn't you?

As it turns out, he's our new comrade. He got special orders from the TDF and came over from the FBI for our sake.

The FBI? That's reassuring! Taki, I'm counting on you!

By the way… what kind of guy is this Colonel Zol?

A lot of the FBI's best agents who tracked him down have been taken out…

He's skilled at brainwashing people, he's a master of disguise, and he'll throw every trick in the book at you… He's got plenty of talent as a commander, too.
You sure know a lot. Does the FBI really dig up that much?
So one of their top executives is finally making his entrance…
[HERO2]! The command satellite's survey data shows an abnormally high energy reading!
Command satellite?

Yeah…

A machine is parked in geostationary orbit, carrying the energy our Roaring Steel needs along with all sorts of survey equipment.
With the command satellite, we can detect heat and electromagnetic pulses that even the TDF's survey satellites can't pick up.
So… what's this energy reading the command satellite picked up?

This is the result of scanning energy consumption and heat output across all of Japan…

We haven't seen a reading this large… since your modification surgery, Mr. Hongo!!

Hongo, it wasn't just chance that we met you!

Back then, a huge energy reading came up just like this one! In other words, we came down to Earth aiming for that spot.
[HERO2]… Rather than "came down," that was closer to a crash.
Meaning?
Meaning Shocker's plotting something again.
So one of their top executives is finally making his entrance, huh?
…Only to go down in flames, right? It doesn't matter what kind of enemy shows up. Because we're here!
That's quite some confidence…

That's right…

You might not know it, Mr. Taki, but [HERO2] and Mr. Hongo are both amazing…
Heh heh heh… I'll look forward to that.
He's kinda creepy…
Well, anyway… it means Shocker's plotting something again.
Taki… So this is Shocker's secret base?
It's close to the spot where the massive energy release was detected, too.
But it's strangely quiet, isn't it?
But… it's kind of quiet, huh?
Heh heh heh… Ha ha ha! Welcome to our Shocker.

What!?

Don't tell me, Taki… you're…?
Heh heh heh…
I have no further use for this face!
You!?
Allow me to introduce myself properly! Dispatched to Shocker's Japan Branch, former chief of the Middle East Branch: Colonel Zol!
A Shocker executive!?
Those who hear my name… and see my true face are certain to die!! Scorpion Man, attack!

Heh heh heh…

Takeshi Hongo… I was made to beat you! I'll stop at nothing to win! Here I come!
The enemy has broken into the base! T-tell Colonel Zol!
My proud Shocker scientists… Has the analysis produced a satisfactory answer from the computer?

Yes, sir…

Among the million people stored in the computer, there was no man with a body strong enough to become a cyborg surpassing Takeshi Hongo.
What!?
There's no one!? Are you saying no one exists with the talent to defeat Takeshi Hongo?

P-please wait… Colonel Zol!

It's true… no one surpasses Takeshi Hongo in overall ability, but we have found someone whose strength and fighting instincts exceed even Hongo's!
What!? Why didn't you say so sooner! Well, who is he? This man?

Yes, sir…

Nationality: Japan. Name: Hayato Ichimonji. Occupation: freelance photographer. That is the man.

Very good…

Capture that man at once and perform the cyborg surgery! Go!!
Eeee…
Talk! What is Shocker plotting? Please, tell me!

It's no use, Taki… This is a combat cyborg.

Most likely… they built it so it can't speak, just in case.
That's nasty… If Shocker conquers the world, is everybody gonna end up like this?
By the way, Taki… You're really you this time, right?
Yeah… Never in my wildest dreams did I think a fake of me would show up.
Still, he sure looked a lot like you.
Still, he really did look a lot like you.
Oh no!?
Look at that! Shocker doesn't think twice about killing its own!
Hey, hang in there! Hey! Damn it, it's no use…

Oh!? What's this?

One of those dying messages, huh? Let's see now, what's it say?

"Redir Rekcohs"… What? What on earth does that mean?
"Redir Rekcohs"? Some kind of code? A person's name? It's no good, I don't have the slightest idea…
"Redir Rekcohs"? Some kind of code? Could it be someone's name? It's no good, I can't make heads or tails of it.
Damn it… Shocker, I won't forgive you!!
Their security's awfully tight, huh?
The command satellite's survey data is still showing a high energy reading.
Colonel Zol's actually a big chicken. I bet he's scared of us, right? Gotta be…
Ha ha ha… You sure are confident, [HERO4].

Hee hee hee…

It's not like I'm the one fighting! You two do your best! Protecting a lady is a man's job, you know.
Right, right… Protecting a lady, that is, which certain people aren't.
What's that supposed to mean… [HERO2], you meanie!
Hongo! Security's too tight. We can't go in from the front.

Yeah… Same over here!

All right… Taki, I'm leaving this to you! We'll…

Wait! I've got a good idea…

Hongo, draw them off for me! While they're distracted, I'll sneak inside the secret base. I'm going to find out what Shocker's plotting!!
But…

No… Let me do this!

Colonel Zol has taken out a lot of my friends at the FBI. I want to avenge them!

Besides… I've got to pay him back for that look-alike!
Taki…
Shhh, shhh, shhh, shhh… Nngh… Curse you, Takeshi Hongo… We'll settle this another time!

Eeee!!

C-Colonel Zol!! Takeshi Hongo and his allies have appeared!!

What did you say!?

Send in the new-model combatants I brought from the Middle East!
Is Hayato Ichimonji's modification surgery still not finished?

Yes, sir…

The body modification is complete, and we have just begun preparations for the brain modification surgery.

uncertain: U00541-U00543: dying message ダイラ カツヨシ is ショッカライダ (Shocker Rider) read backwards, solved in B0008; rendered 'Redir Rekcohs' so the English also reads 'Shocker Rider' backwards. B0008 must stay consistent.
U00501: 滅び行く…か？ read as the heroine finishing [HERO2]'s line ('...only to go down in flames')
U00534: 今度は大丈夫なんだろうな rendered 'You're really you this time, right?' (after the fake Taki)
U00551: 誰かさんと違って read as teasing the heroine (she is not a lady who needs protecting / does not protect); rendered loosely
U00515/U00525: narration-kind rows continue Zol's lines from U00514/U00524
omissions_kept: U00499: Taki (actually the disguised Zol) silent; kept as ellipsis

reversed-word code; English reversal of 'Shocker Rider'
